Help.title: How does it work?
Help.intro: Short answers to the most common questions.

checklist.title: Get started in 3 steps
checklist.billD: Add each bill once, like rent or electricity. Its payment is created automatically every month.
checklist.paidD: After a bill is paid, press {markPaid} next to it.
checklist.remD: A message arrives before a bill is due, so nothing is paid late.

addBill.s2: Type a name, pick a category and write the amount.
addBill.s3: Choose the day it is due and how often it comes back (every month, every year or just once). Then save it.

repeat.q: The bill is not monthly. What now?
repeat.s1: When adding or editing a bill, choose how often it comes back: every few months, every year or only once.
repeat.s2: An end month can also be set. Then a bill that ends, like a loan, stops by itself.

editBill.q: How is a bill changed (name, amount, day)?
editBill.s1: Open {bills} and press {edit} next to the bill.
editBill.s2: Change what is needed and save.

pause.s2: Press {pause} next to the bill and confirm.
pause.s3: No new payments or reminders will come. What is already paid stays in the history.

resume.q: How is a paused bill brought back?
resume.s2: Press {resume} next to the bill. New payments start again.

seePayments.q: Where is what needs to be paid shown?
seePayments.s1: Open {payments}. It shows the bills of one month, grouped by category.
seePayments.s2: Use the arrows next to the month name to go to another month. On a phone, tap the month name to pick one.
seePayments.s3: Press {today} to come back to this month.

filters.s1: Above the list is {search}. Type a name to search.
filters.s2: Use the filters to show only unpaid bills or one category, and choose how the list is sorted.
filters.s3: Open {calendar} and tap a day to see only the payments of that day.

markPaid.q: How is a bill marked as paid?
markPaid.s3: If another amount was paid or on another day, change it, then confirm.

editPayment.q: A different amount was paid. Can it be changed?
editPayment.s1: Open {payments} and press {editPayment} (the pencil) next to the bill.
editPayment.s2: Change the amount, the date or the note, then save. It works for paid bills too.

revert.q: A bill was marked as paid by mistake
revert.s2: Press {revert}. The bill goes back to unpaid.

deletePayment.s1: Press {deletePayment} next to it and confirm.
deletePayment.s2: The next payments of this bill stay. To stop a bill completely, pause it.

export.q: How are payments downloaded (Excel or PDF)?
export.s2: Next to the month name press XLSX or PDF.
export.s3: Pick this month or the whole year. The file downloads to the device.
export.s4: Do not see the buttons? Turn them on in {settings} → {tabReports}.

share.q: How is a month sent to someone by email?
share.s1: In {settings} → {tabReports} turn on sharing. Frequently used addresses can be saved.
share.s2: Then open {payments} and press the share button ({share}) next to the month name.

reminders.s2: Turn on email, browser or Telegram reminders and choose when they should arrive.
reminders.s3: Email and Telegram need a short setup first. The page shows what to fill in.

backup.s2: Press {backup}, choose what to include and download the file.
backup.s3: Keep the file in a safe place.

restore.q: How is data brought back from a backup?
restore.s2: Press {restore} and choose the backup file.
restore.s3: Check the comparison and confirm. Careful: this replaces the current data.
restore.s4: Changed course? Right after a restore the previous data can be brought back, on the same page.

categories.q: How are categories added or changed?
categories.s2: Add custom ones, or rename and recolor the existing ones.
categories.s3: A category that is not needed can be removed. If a bill still uses it, it is only hidden.

language.q: How are the language, currency or time zone changed?
language.s2: There the default currency, the number format, the time zone and the selectable languages are set. The language can also be switched in the menu.

account.q: How are the email or password changed?
account.s2: Change the email or password there. Forgot the password? Use the link on the sign-in page.
account.s3: The account can also be deleted there. This cannot be undone.

install.q: How is the app put on a phone?
install.s1: Open the app in the phone’s browser.
install.s2: In the browser menu choose “Add to Home screen” (on iPhone: Share → “Add to Home Screen”).
